nodes.name: 十一盏
who: the old keeper of the fire
nodes.light: warm orange from the small gate fire in the near foreground, a dull red glow of burning wheat low on the far left horizon, and eleven small steady lights of different colours spread across the plain
nodes.camera: from high on the city wall above the gate, looking down and outward over the plain; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a night in early autumn on a wide plain of white stones, seen from the top of a stone city wall. Far below in the near foreground, small and sharp, a small fire burns on bare ground at the foot of the east gate, with three people around it. An old man crouches at it, feeding it with iron tongs: sixty-five, small, bent-backed but with his head up, untidy grey-white hair as if dusted with ash, coal-red eyes, a soot streak across one cheekbone, a leather cloak patched many times with five old burnt holes left unmended; a wolf pelt lies spread on a flat stone beside him, unused. Next to him a sturdy square-shouldered woman of thirty splits firewood with an axe, a long deep-teal braid coiled on top of her head, light blue eyes, a faint old burn scar on her right cheek as we see her; behind her a neat stack of logs, one layer crosswise and one layer lengthwise, as straight as a wall. An old woman with white-streaked wheat-gold hair, a short bow on her back and a small pouch at her waist, has just sat down at the old man's other side. Out on the plain beyond, in the dark among the white stones, eleven camps are laid out in a wide ring around the city, one beside the next, and over each camp hangs a single steady light: eleven crowns, each with a core of a different colour, one huge and yellow nearest the wall, then pale blue-green, then green, then red, then seven smaller ones. Far to the left the horizon glows where wheat fields are burning. Sparks and ash drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 取源稿第129到130行：十一个王的营扎到城下，冠上的核夜里像十一盏灯；欧德添柴、黛拉劈柴、嘉琳坐到火边。欧德六十五岁，ge14_ode 的立绘是十五岁那一张，年老的样子 text 里写死了，参考图会偏年轻，要主会话定。

nodes.name: 低下的灯
nodes.light: a deep blue dusk with the warm gold of the crown and of lamps held by the crowd, the stranger lit from the front by their light
nodes.camera: from the back of the crowd at head height, looking across the open square to the middle; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in the paved square at the middle of a stone city, packed with silent people, lamps held up on poles. In the centre of the picture, in an open space on the stones, a very tall stranger stands alone, a man of no particular age, his face dusty from a long road, hair the colour of straw, wearing a plain travelling coat; he has taken off the cloth from a plain gold crown, a single ring with no seat, and holds it up in both hands. Wherever he has walked the shadows on the stones are shorter than the others. Around him on both sides, in two blocks of arrayed soldiers, a dozen kings stand and kneel in fur-trimmed mantles, and each king's crown has a coloured core that glows like a small lamp, one huge and yellow, one pale blue-green, one green, one red, others smaller; and almost all of the lamp-crowns are bowed down, the kings with their heads lowered, as if a wind had pressed flames flat. In the near middle ground a heavy king in a yellow-cored crown is stumbling, his head bent forward so far that two men are holding him up by the arms to take the crown off him. Along the foot of the city wall on the left, in shadow, a very old man with red hair sits on the ground hugging a worn old book-chest. At the back of the right-hand block, taller than every knight beside him by a head and broad as a wall, a bare-headed man in rough homespun with a stone-grey tinge to his skin stands with his head up and a white stone at his feet, looking straight at the crown. No one else in the square has their head up. Specks of light and dust float large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 取源稿第135到137行：外乡人举冠，说谁戴得起，谁就是王；东城王第一个低头，十一个王一个接一个低头，将军祭司骑士都试了；墙根下书箱老人和阵后头卸了金甲的人不低头。祂们是谁不点破，只写样子。

nodes.name: 抬头
who: the old keeper of the fire
nodes.light: the first gold-white sunrise pouring straight at us from behind the standing stranger, hard gold edge-light on every outline, deep blue shadows lengthening toward us
nodes.camera: low, from inside the gate looking east out along the road, with the sun low behind the stranger; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise at the east gate of a stone city, seen from just inside the gateway looking out to the east along the road. In the middle distance stands a very tall stranger with his back to the rising sun, so that he is a dark outline against it with a blaze of white-gold light spilling out all round him: straw-coloured hair edged with light, a plain travelling coat. He is bending a little and has just lowered a plain gold crown, a single ring with no seat, onto the head of an old man crouched at a small fire in the middle of the picture. The old man is sixty-five, small, bent-backed, untidy grey-white hair, coal-red eyes, a patched leather cloak with old burnt holes, a soot streak on one cheekbone: he has not moved aside, and he is lifting his face to the light, his head coming up, his eyes wide open and steady, his mouth closed. Beside him on the left an old woman with white-streaked wheat-gold hair sits clutching a small pouch of wheat grains against her stomach, looking at him and not making a sound. In the near left foreground a sturdy woman with a deep-teal braid coiled on her head runs in toward the fire, seen from behind. The long shadow of the stranger runs all the way back along the road toward us, through the open gate and on into the city, across the stones at our feet. Far behind the stranger, the plain lies in white-gold light, with the fires of the camps going out one by one in thin smoke. Dust and ash blow large and out of focus through the light across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取源稿第143、144行：外乡人把冠轻轻戴到欧德头上，他没有躲，东边的天在发白，他抬起了头；日头从外乡人背后升起，影子从东门拖到西门；黛拉跑到火边，嘉琳攥着腰上那袋麦。老欧德的样子 text 里写死，参考图是年轻的欧德。

nodes.name: 交火
who: the old keeper of the fire
nodes.light: clear bright morning light from the open end of the gate passage behind her, warm gold on the stones, the flame in her hands a small orange point
nodes.camera: from inside the gate tunnel, a little low, looking toward the woman as she walks in toward us; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: full morning at the east gate of a stone city, the sky entirely clear. We stand inside the vaulted gate passage and look back out toward the road. In the middle of the picture a woman of thirty walks toward us through the passage, carrying a small flame in both cupped hands: sturdy, square-shouldered, a long deep-teal braid coiled on top of her head, light blue eyes, a faint old burn scar on her right cheek as we see it, a leather apron. A through-draught is blowing along the passage and it presses her apron flat against her legs, but the tip of the flame between her palms stands straight up. Her face is solemn and steady and her eyes are fixed on the flame. Behind her, in the open end of the passage, the small gate fire burns on bare ground in the daylight, with an old man standing beside it, sixty-five, small and bent, grey-white hair, coal-red eyes, a patched cloak, and on his head a plain gold crown, a ring with no seat, which catches the morning light like a thin circle of sunrise; he is standing very straight with one hand lifted a little toward her, as if he has just said something and is waiting. A wolf pelt lies on a flat stone beside the fire. Along the road beyond them, small, a few townspeople are looking at the pair. Dust and a few grains of wheat drift large and out of focus in the light across the near corners.
nodes.note: 取源稿第149行：欧德戴着冠回了东门，天亮以后把火交给黛拉，说了那一句老话，黛拉捧着接来的火穿过门洞，穿堂风把围裙吹得贴住腿，火尖稳稳朝上。老欧德样子 text 写死，参考图是年轻的。

notes: 这一段主线（3000年坠叶月到3001年萌芽月）里没有旅伴或相遇的人死：黛拉约3060年、莱奥约3070年、嘉琳约3010年，欧德活着，都在这一段以外，所以 fates、deaths 都是空的。
欧德六十五岁，ge14_ode 的立绘和 who 资料是十五岁那一位，出图时参考图会偏年轻，要么先给老欧德另出一张，要么 text 里的年老写法压过参考图，请主会话定。
背冠的外乡人、书箱老人、卸了金甲的人在 n2 里只写了样子，没点破是谁，也没写神光。
n1 里十一顶冠只写了源稿给了颜色的几顶，别的写成 seven smaller ones。
莱奥下风头拦骑兵、黛拉掌中火、莱奥冠殿前跪下几拍有画面但任务单只许四幅，没写，需要加幅请主会话说。
